snippet.title: Life Balance - Announcement Trailer | Co-op Physics Climbing Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Life Balance on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4157660/

Every life choice you make straps a real, physical burden onto your wobbly ragdoll. Then you have to climb with it.

I'm a solo dev and this is the first trailer for Life Balance (after I redid the visuals for the game), a physics comedy climbing game you can play alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op. Wishlisting on Steam honestly helps more than anything else right now, so thank you if you do 💙

#LifeBalance #IndieGame #CoopGames #PhysicsGame #Steam
